rendered:
According to the text on page 2, under the US Advanced Battery Consortium standard, an EV battery reaches the end of its usable life when its current cell capacity is less than 80% of the rated capacity.

When an EV battery reaches the end of its usable life, it can be reused/repurposed, recycled, or disposed in landfills. The review states that all of these options are possible, but eventually, the batteries will all need to be recycled.

question: Under the US Advanced Battery Consortium standard, when does an EV battery reach the end of its usable life, what can be done with such batteries, and which of those does the review say they all eventually need?
